issues.where: upper limb above the main vortex, also in the upper-right of the crop grid
issues.what: A narrow amber line rides just outside the bright limb and reads as a second edge; the target goes from one bright edge into a continuous soft glow.
issues.fix: Blend the narrow outer line into the atmospheric falloff while preserving the contour and the breadth of the halo.

issues.where: sky tiles B through H, especially the dust band in F, G and H
issues.what: Fine star points and the grain of the galactic dust are a little less distinct. This also appears in the full hold frame.
issues.fix: Recover the smallest stellar cores and dust texture without raising the black floor or sharpening the whole frame.

issues.where: tile I, lightning on the lower shadow-side clouds
issues.what: The pink-white lightning reads a touch hotter and more concentrated in the cores than the target, competing more with the dim branches.
issues.fix: Pull the core highlights down slightly and keep the fine branches visible against the dark folds.

issues.where: tile C, sun, horizontal flare and nearby stars
issues.what: The amber veil is slightly fuller and the horizontal flare is less defined away from the core; faint stars near the halo are less legible. The effect is visible in the full terrain frame too.
issues.fix: Reduce the diffuse amber veil slightly and bring back the thin horizontal flare and adjacent faint star points without moving the sun.

issues.where: tiles B, F, G and H, terrain limb and upper star field away from the sun
issues.what: The distant horizon and first cloud bands are slightly softer and warmer, and the finer blue-white stars have less point contrast.
issues.fix: Restore crisper separation between the horizon and the cloud bands, keep the sky neutral-cool, and recover the finer star points.

issues.where: tiles A, D, E, F and I, raking light across cloud ridges and shafts
issues.what: The lit cloud slopes are fractionally warmer and more filled in, reducing separation between gold edges, shadow faces and adjacent shafts compared with the target.
issues.fix: Dial back the warm midtones and restore local light-to-shadow separation while retaining the same cloud silhouettes and ray directions.
